**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- This staff is tapered at the base and carved into a gem-studded twist at the top. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to identify elemental creatures. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells. Staff of Elemental Power **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Price** 230 gp ---
  • **Cantrip** [_frostbite_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1539)
  • **1st** [_breathe fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1457), [_pummeling rubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1642), [_thunderstrike_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1721)
  • **2nd** [_blazing bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1450), [_resist energy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1651)
Staff of Elemental Power (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Price** 900 gp ---
  • **3rd** [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1530), [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1586)
  • **4th** resist energy, [_wall of fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1748)
Staff of Elemental Power (Major) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 279 **Price** 4,000 gp ---
  • **5th** [_howling blizzard_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1559), [_wall of ice_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1750)
  • **6th** [_chain lightning_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1462), fireball
name: Staff of Elemental Power
